Newsletter Subscription to Zoho CRM Leads – WSO2 Integration Requirement
17 Nov 2026 · Prepared by the integration owner · Version 1.0 (draft for WSO2 team review)
1. Background
Guests can subscribe to the newsletter from several channels. Each time a guest enters an email address:
1.  The subscription must be stored in the Zoho CRM Leads module.
2.  The lead must carry a clear Newsletter tag and source, so it can be included in all future communications.
3.  The lead must record which channel the subscription came from: Web, Mobile, Agent Booking or Agency.
4.  The guest must receive an automated confirmation email saying they have subscribed.
The WSO2 team will build and host the API that receives the subscription from the front end, transforms it, writes it to Zoho CRM and returns the agreed response.
2. Scope
In scope for the WSO2 team
• Expose one REST API: POST /newsletter/v1/subscribe (through WSO2 API Manager, with mediation in WSO2 Micro Integrator or the APIM mediation layer).
• Read and validate the channel from the request header.
• Validate and transform the request body (including building the Mobile field).
• Create or update the lead in Zoho CRM (no duplicates), set Lead Source, channel and the Newsletter tag.
• Manage Zoho OAuth tokens (refresh, cache, secure storage).
• Return the agreed success response, or a standard error response.
• Logging, error handling, retries and monitoring.
Out of scope for the WSO2 team
• Front-end screens and the subscription form.
• The confirmation email content and template (owned by the Zoho CRM admin, see Section 8).
• Zoho CRM field and picklist setup (owned by the Zoho CRM admin, see Section 9). The WSO2 team should confirm the setup is in place before testing.
3. End-to-end flow
1.  Guest enters details on Web, Mobile app, Agent Booking screen or Agency portal.
2.  Front end (or its backend) calls the WSO2 API with the channel header and the JSON body.
3.  WSO2 validates the header and body. If anything is invalid, it returns 400 and stops.
4.  WSO2 builds Mobile = country code + space + contact number.
5.  WSO2 removes empty fields and sets fixed values (Lead Source = Newsletter, channel, tag).
6.  WSO2 gets a valid Zoho access token (from cache, or refreshes it).
7.  WSO2 calls the Zoho CRM upsert API on the Leads module, using Email as the duplicate check.
8.  WSO2 makes sure the Newsletter tag is on the lead (in the same call, or with the add-tags API).
9.  Zoho CRM workflow rule sends the confirmation email to the guest.
10.  WSO2 returns the agreed response to the front end.
4. API contract
4.1 Endpoint
Item
Value
Method
POST
Path
/newsletter/v1/subscribe
Content type
application/json
Authentication (front end to WSO2)
WSO2 APIM OAuth2 or API key. Zoho credentials are never sent to or seen by the front end.
Environments
UAT and Production, each with its own Zoho credentials
4.2 Request headers
Header
Mandatory
Allowed values
Notes

Yes
WEB, MOBILE, AGENT_BOOKING, AGENCY
Case-insensitive. Missing or any other value returns 400.
Content-Type
Yes
application/json

Authorization or API key header
Yes
As issued by WSO2 APIM

X-Correlation-ID
No
Any unique string
If not sent, WSO2 generates one and returns it in the response header.
4.3 Request body (from the front end)
{
  "data": {
    "Email": "newsletter.guest@example.invalid",
    "First_Name": "test",
    "Last_Name": "guest",
    "country code": "+966",
    "contact": "5123456789",
    "Industry": "",
    "Lead_Source": "",
    "No_of_Employees": "",
    "Country": "",
    "Currency": ""
  }
}
Note: the sample shared earlier was missing a comma after the contact value. The front-end team must send valid JSON as shown above.
4.4 Success response (to the front end)
HTTP 200 OK
{
  "data": {
    "Email": "newsletter.guest@example.invalid",
    "First_Name": "test",
    "Last_Name": "guest",
    "Mobile": "+966 512345678",
    "Industry": "",
    "Lead_Source": "",
    "No_of_Employees": "",
    "Country": "",
    "Currency": ""
  }
}
Rules for the response:
• country code and contact are not returned. They are replaced by one field, Mobile.
• All other fields are returned with the same names, in the same order.
• Return 200 for both a new lead and an existing lead that was updated, so the front end handles one success case.
• See open question Q2 on whether Lead_Source should return "Newsletter" instead of the empty value.
4.5 Error response
{
  "error": {
    "code": "INVALID_CHANNEL",
    "message": "X-Channel header is missing or not one of WEB, MOBILE, AGENT_BOOKING, AGENCY",
    "correlationId": "7f3c2a1e-..."
  }
}
HTTP status
Error code
When
400
INVALID_CHANNEL
X-Channel missing or not an allowed value
400
INVALID_REQUEST
Body is not valid JSON or data object is missing
400
INVALID_EMAIL
Email missing or not a valid format
400
INVALID_MOBILE
Country code or contact number fails the rules in Section 5
400
MISSING_FIELD
A mandatory field is empty (message names the field)
401 / 403
UNAUTHORIZED
Front-end credentials missing or invalid (WSO2 APIM standard)
429
RATE_LIMITED
Caller exceeds the WSO2 throttling limit
502
CRM_ERROR
Zoho CRM returned an error after retries
504
CRM_TIMEOUT
Zoho CRM did not respond in time after retries
Zoho error details must be logged but not passed back to the front end as raw text.

Important: empty strings must be left out of the Zoho request. Sending "" for number, currency or picklist fields makes Zoho reject the record.
5.2 Mobile number rules
1.  Remove spaces, dashes, brackets and dots from contact.
2.  Remove one leading 0 if present (e.g. 0512345678 becomes 512345678).
3.  Remove the country code if the guest typed it inside contact (e.g. 912345678901 with code +966 becomes 512345678).
4.  For +966 (Saudi Arabia): the result must be exactly 9 digits starting with 5. Otherwise return 400 INVALID_MOBILE.
5.  For other country codes: total length (country code digits + number) must be 8 to 15 digits (E.164).
6.  Never cut digits off to make a number fit. A wrong number is rejected, not shortened.
Data issue to confirm: the sample request has contact = 5123456789 (10 digits), but the expected response shows +966 512345678 (9 digits, last digit dropped). Saudi mobile numbers are 9 digits after +966, so the sample request most likely has a typo. Under the rules above, the 10-digit sample would be rejected with INVALID_MOBILE. See Q1.
6. Zoho CRM integration details
The Zoho org is on the India data centre, uses API v8, and already has Submission_Channel and Marketing_Opt_In fields on Leads. Details and a sample curl were received from the owner on 17 Nov 2026.
Credentials: the Client ID and Client Secret are deliberately not written in this doc. They are shared with the WSO2 team only through a secure channel and loaded into the WSO2 Secure Vault.
Item
Value / requirement
API base URL
https://www.zohoapis.in (India data centre)
Accounts (token) URL
https://accounts.zoho.in
API console
https://api-console.zoho.in
API version
v8
Sample call received
POST https://www.zohoapis.in/crm/v8/Leads (plain insert). The pasted curl had extra characters after /Leads from a link; the correct URL ends at /Leads.
Operation WSO2 must use
POST https://www.zohoapis.in/crm/v8/Leads/upsert with "duplicate_check_fields": ["Email"]. Plain insert creates a new lead each time the same guest subscribes.
Auth header
Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {access_token}
OAuth client type
Self Client (addendum, 17 Nov 2026). No redirect URI is needed.
Scopes (confirmed)
ZohoCRM.modules.leads.ALL,ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ
Step 1 – grant code
In the Zoho API Console (India) → Self Client → Generate Code tab → paste the scopes above → pick a time duration (10 minutes) → add a description → Create → copy the code.
Step 2 – access token
Within the time duration, POST https://accounts.zoho.in/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=authorization_code, client_id, client_secret, code. The reply has an access_token (valid 1 hour) and a refresh_token (does not expire).
Step 3 – keep it working
An access token alone stops working after 1 hour. WSO2 stores the refresh_token in Secure Vault and gets a new access token with POST https://accounts.zoho.in/oauth/v2/token with grant_type=refresh_token, client_id, client_secret, refresh_token. Cache it; refresh before expiry, or once on 401 INVALID_TOKEN, then retry the call once.
Tag
"Tag": [{"name": "Newsletter"}] inside the record. The separate add-tags API is not used (the confirmed scopes do not include a tags scope). Existing tags on the lead must be kept.
Workflow
"trigger": ["workflow"] (already in the sample) so the confirmation email rule fires
Field check
ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ lets WSO2 read the Leads field list (GET /crm/v8/settings/fields?module=Leads) to confirm the picklist values for Lead_Source and Submission_Channel before go-live.
Environment
Confirm whether these credentials are for the UAT (sandbox) or Production org. The other environment needs its own Self Client tokens (Q11).

+912345678901
Built from country code + contact. See storage format below.

Newsletter subscription via {channel}, e.g. Newsletter subscription via Web

Front-end value, only if not empty
City, State, Inquiry_Message, Facebook_Lead_Received_Date, leadchain0__Social_Lead_ID
Facebook lead data
Not sent
Mobile storage format: existing CRM records store mobile in E.164 with no space (+912345678901). Recommendation: WSO2 stores +912345678901 (no space) in Zoho so search, duplicate checks and SMS tools match existing data. The API response to the front end still returns +966 512345678 with a space, as agreed in Section 4.4 (Q10).
6.2 Zoho request built by WSO2 (sample guest)
curl --location 'https://www.zohoapis.in/crm/v8/Leads/upsert' \
--header 'Authorization: Zoho-oauthtoken {access_token}' \
--header 'Content-Type: application/json' \
--data-raw '{
  "data": [
    {
      "Email": "newsletter.guest@example.invalid",
      "First_Name": "test",
      "Last_Name": "guest",
      "Mobile": "+912345678901",
      "Company": "Individual Guest",
      "Lead_Source": "Newsletter",
      "Submission_Channel": "Web",
      "Marketing_Opt_In": true,
      "Description": "Newsletter subscription via Web",
      "Tag": [ { "name": "Newsletter" } ]
    }
  ],
  "duplicate_check_fields": [ "Email" ],
  "trigger": [ "workflow" ]
}'
Zoho returns "action": "insert" for a new lead or "action": "update" for an existing one, with "status": "success" and the record id. WSO2 logs the action and record ID, then returns the Section 4.4 response.
7. Duplicate and repeat subscriptions
Case
Expected behaviour
New email
Create lead, set Newsletter tag, channel and Lead Source. Confirmation email sent. Return 200.
Email already a lead
Update the same lead (name, mobile if sent), add Newsletter tag if missing. Return 200. No second lead.
Same email from a different channel
Update the lead. Channel field shows the latest channel (see Q5 if first channel must be kept).
Email already a Contact in Zoho (existing guest)
To be decided, see Q6.
8. Confirmation email
Recommended approach: the email is sent by a Zoho CRM workflow rule, not by WSO2.
• Rule on the Leads module: when a lead is created or edited and Tag contains Newsletter (or Lead Source = Newsletter), send the "Newsletter subscription confirmed" email template to the lead's Email.
• Benefits: the email template can be changed by the CRM team without a WSO2 release, and every subscription stored in CRM gets the email.
• The WSO2 team only needs to pass "trigger": ["workflow"] in the upsert call.
• To decide: should a repeat subscription send the email again? (Q7)
9. Zoho CRM setup needed before WSO2 testing (CRM admin)
1.  Add Newsletter as a value in the Lead Source picklist.
2.  Add Web, Mobile App, Agent Booking, Agency as values in the existing Submission Channel field (API name Submission_Channel), if it is a picklist.
3.  Create the tag Newsletter in the Leads module.
4.  Make Company non-mandatory in the Leads layout, or confirm the default Individual Guest (Q4).
5.  Create the confirmation email template and the workflow rule (Section 8). The rule must check Lead Source = Newsletter, so Facebook and other leads sent with the workflow trigger do not get the newsletter email.
6.  Make sure Email is set as a unique / duplicate-check field for Leads.
7.  Self Client is used (no redirect URI). The WSO2 team generates the grant code and tokens with the confirmed scopes ZohoCRM.modules.leads.ALL,ZohoCRM.settings.fields.READ, following Section 6 steps 1 to 3. Repeat for the second environment.
10. Non-functional requirements
Area
Requirement
Response time
95% of calls answered within 3 seconds (Zoho call included)
Zoho timeout
10 seconds per call
Retries
Up to 2 retries with back-off (1 s, then 3 s) on Zoho 5xx, 429 or timeout. No retry on 4xx data errors.
Throttling
WSO2 APIM limit per caller (suggested 60 requests per minute per IP / app) to stop form spam and protect Zoho API credits
Security
HTTPS only. CORS allowed only for the approved web domains. No Zoho credentials outside WSO2.
Privacy
Email and mobile must be masked in logs (e.g. tl***@gmail.com, +966 51*****81). Follow Saudi PDPL for personal data.
Logging
Log correlation ID, channel, result (created / updated / failed), Zoho record ID and response time for every call
Monitoring and alerts
Alert when the error rate is above 5% in 15 minutes, or when the Zoho token refresh fails
Failed calls
Calls that still fail after retries are written to an error queue or table for re-processing, so no subscription is lost

13. Deliverables from the WSO2 team
1.  API definition (OpenAPI 3.0) published in WSO2 API Manager for UAT and Production.
2.  Mediation / integration flow (Micro Integrator project or APIM mediation sequence) in the source repository.
3.  Secure Vault setup for the Zoho credentials.
4.  Postman collection covering all test cases in Section 11.
5.  Test results from UAT, including screenshots of the created leads in Zoho CRM.
6.  Short run book: how to rotate the Zoho refresh token, read the logs, and re-process failed calls.
14. Acceptance criteria
• A subscription from each of the four channels creates (or updates) exactly one lead in Zoho CRM with Lead Source = Newsletter, the Newsletter tag and the correct channel.
• The guest receives the confirmation email.
• The front end gets the response in the exact format in Section 4.4.
• Invalid requests are rejected with the right error code and nothing is written to CRM.
• No Zoho credentials or raw personal data appear in logs or front-end code.
